timeline.summary: On 15 May 2026 Balmer Lawrie adjourned its board meeting to 17 May 2026, deferring FY26 audited results, a possible final dividend and a review of DIPAM capital restructuring that may include a buyback, bonus or split.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹743.91 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹84.52 Cr.
Kavita Bhavsar, Company Secretary, recommended ₹4.25 dividend per ₹10 equity share on 17.10M shares for FY2026 via adjourned Board Meeting on 17 May 2026.
On 17 May 2026 Balmer Lawrie's board, after reviewing DIPAM's November 2024 capital-restructuring guidelines, decided not to recommend the issue of bonus shares.
On 17 May 2026 Balmer Lawrie's board decided not to buy back the company's shares after reviewing DIPAM's CPSE capital-restructuring guidelines, following its 5 and 15 May intimations.

On 17 May 2026 Balmer Lawrie's press release reported FY26 net income of ₹2,784.60 Cr (up 8.03%), PBT of ₹330.87 Cr (up 5.44%) and PAT of ₹245.68 Cr (up 5.53%), with a recommended 42.50% final dividend on top of a 42.50% interim.

On 27 May 2026 BSE fined Balmer Lawrie ₹7,50,480 (inclusive of GST) for board-composition non-compliance in Q4FY26; NSE imposed a matching ₹7,50,480 fine on 1 June 2026, and the company sought a waiver from BSE.

upcoming_events.description: Adjourned board meeting to consider FY26 audited results, final dividend and DIPAM capital restructuring review
